attributes.name: unordered
attributes.digest: Ignore Order
attributes.description: When comparing arrays, the order of elements is normally taken into account.Whenis set to 1, comparison will be performed without regard for the element order, such that [ 1, 2, 3 ] and [ 2, 3, 1 ] are considered equivalent.

messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Convert a list to an array for comparison.
messages.description: Convert an incoming list to an array, then process as described for themessage.

messages.name: array
messages.description: Compare an array . Set the array to be compared in the right inlet without triggering output. In the left inlet, set the array to compare to and immediately trigger the array out. In the right inlet, the array is stored and no output is generated. In the left inlet, the array is compared to any array received in the right inlet and a result (0/1) is sent to the outlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Compare the left and right inputs again and output the result (0/1).
messages.description: Compare the left and right inputs again and output the result (0 - Unequal/ 1 - Equal)
